scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional Tol palette and clean typographic hierarchy elevate this above generic, but a large empty lower half of the viewport wastes whitespace and the hot-pink phylum count dots share the same hue as search-match highlights, creating ambiguity at rest.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Topology-only encoding with no quantitative channels means zero-baseline and lie-factor rules are inapplicable; color correctly encodes categorical rank, fixed circle radii don't encode data values, descendant counts are honest text labels, and the sole robustness concern is the name+depth composite join key instead of a stable id.
scores.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() call before new transitions in update(), so rapid clicking (toggle, expand/collapse all) during a 500ms transition can cause nodes to snap to incorrect positions; all other checks pass — search is debounced 200ms, no brush/zoom stale closures, no cross-view dispatch loops, and pointer events unify mouse/touch cleanly.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Progressive disclosure keeps working memory load low (only 2 levels visible by default, ~15 nodes), the 6-color Tol palette maps cleanly to taxonomic ranks, and +N count badges communicate hidden scale without exposing it — the main risk is that fully expanding all 200 nodes would test label legibility, but the collapsed default state is clear and well-managed.
